svg.text: Pipeline and hardware of the simulator (every box shows the data it stores, with example values)
in program order, stops at 1st stall
PC follows the prediction; refetch at n+2
idx = PC mod 8, 1-bit taken; miss = not taken
loads wait for older store addresses;
a matching older Sd forwards its data
end of EX: outcome vs prediction
rebuild RAT, refetch in cycle n+2
ROB: reorder buffer (circular queue, program order)
^ head = oldest: commits when done, in order
tail: ISSUE allocates a new entry here
pred (NEW) = predicted taken? dest_tag: register name,
Sd: load/store slot, branch: offset. issue..commit = cycles
A store writes data memory when it is the ROB head.
broadcast wakes up reservation stations / Sd data waiting for the tag
ISSUE allocates a ROB entry for every issued instruction (in order)
red = added in this assignment (BTB, PC control, branch resolution, ROB.pred); dashed red = misprediction recovery (squash + refetch)
